purpose: Turn the GPT voter simulation into an auditable electoral-behaviour observatory without requesting or claiming access to private chain-of-thought.

three_pass_design.D0_DECISION: The original frozen full-environment prompt and schema produce turnout, party probabilities, factor importance and reason codes. No explanatory prose is requested in this pass.
three_pass_design.L0_OBSERVABLE_DELIBERATION: A separate fresh context receives the immutable D0 rows, selected voter cards, the original anonymous context and a closed evidence catalogue. It may explain but may not alter D0.
three_pass_design.CF_BEHAVIOURAL_ABLATIONS: A separate fresh context re-runs the frozen decision task on deterministically modified packets. Counterfactual deltas, not narrative confidence, determine whether a proposed mechanism is supported.

full_2944.non_panel_rows: retain D0 factor simplex and reason codes only

observable_deliberation.evidence_rule: Every directional claim must cite one or more evidence_id values from the row-specific closed catalogue.
observable_deliberation.unsupported_claims_policy: Any unknown evidence id, identity mismatch, altered D0 number or unsupported-claims flag fails the row closed.
observable_deliberation.interpretation: Observable deliberations are model-generated self-explanations. They are hypotheses until confirmed by counterfactual re-runs.

scientific_boundaries: D0 decisions are immutable before any L0 explanation is generated.
L0 cannot be fed back into D0 or historical scoring.
Narrative fluency is never treated as causal evidence.
Counterfactual packets are synthetic diagnostics and never confused with observed facts.
The placebo is evaluated alongside substantive interventions.
2016 and 2021 outcomes remain sealed during D0, L0 and CF generation.
Social R1/R2 parameters remain illustrative until the separate calibration and holdout protocol.
promotion_gate: all requested L0 rows preserve D0 numbers and identities
all evidence references resolve to the closed catalogue
all counterfactual outputs use the same decision model and frozen prompt
counterfactual transforms and hashes are recorded
public UI labels observable deliberation as explanation and counterfactual effects as diagnostics
